source_type: own release (OpenAI blob; reused from benchmarks/raw/HealthBench_Professional, downloaded 2026-09-30)
license: MIT (c) 2026 OpenAI; README asks that examples not be revealed in plain text or images online
split: public eval set (OpenAI keeps a private held-out set)
english: partly (no language field; heuristic classes about 471 of 525 first user turns (90%) as English, others mostly Portuguese and Spanish)
request_fields: conversation.messages (410 single-turn; first user turn = first message)
notes: Reused; hashes match benchmarks/raw/SOURCES.md. 525 examples (consult 236, research 147, writing 142; red_teaming 191). No example text in this manifest (OpenAI contamination request). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: conversation: the first user turn only; language identified with lingua-language-detector 2.1.1 (LanguageDetectorBuilder.from_all_languages().with_preloaded_language_models().build()); an item is non-English only if compute_language_confidence_values on the first user turn gives a top language other than ENGLISH with confidence >= 0.80, every other item (including short ones) counts as English

language_id.rule: non-English iff top language != ENGLISH and confidence >= 0.80 (first user turn)
